$BTC — September 1st Monthly Open Structure

The monthly open is an important area with significant directional movement potential depending on prevailing narrative.

IF dumping into Sept 1st: Look for long around the monthly open (structure permitting)
IF aggressively pumping into Sept 1st: Look for short (structure validation required)

Chart confirms monthly open zones as key technical inflection points.
